يحتووا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَوُوا (yaḥtawū) /jaħ.ta.wuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
# يُحْتَوَوْا (yuḥtawaw) /juħ.ta.waw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
